svg.title: A08 HELIOS PULSE FORGE engineering architecture
svg.desc: Per-pass dispersion and Kerr phase feed a separately defined compressor and energy metric. The diagram requires field retrieval and supplied hardware limits; it does not establish operating safety or full transverse validity.
